title: The Pale Harvest
author: Rafael Vane
blurb: Quentin Dravenmoor, a property surveyor appraising a house that appraises back, has spent three years telling themselves the noises have explanations. Then the excavation crew unearths a door, sealed from the inside — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must hold out until sunrise with the truth about what was invited in before the well refills.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
